A bright sharp horizontal red light bar highlights only the eyes and casts a red reflection across a matte gray wall, while the rest of the portrait falls into deep shadow. Keep the image moody, minimalist, cinematic, and realistic, with natural skin texture, controlled contrast, an 85mm lens at f/2, and portrait 4:5 framing. No text or logo.
